calls.title: 5.0 Enablement + Sales <> MKTG Sync
calls.summary: Growthbook 5.0 aims to democratize experimentation by enabling growth, marketing, and product teams to run tests independently, emphasizing product quality over the speed of delivery. The product introduces multi-interface support, allowing users to operate in various environments and enhancing accessibility for diverse teams. Enhanced features, including an AI-powered visual editor and flexible governance, position Growthbook advantageously against competitors like LaunchDarkly and Amplitude. With new product analytics tightly integrated with experimentation data, teams can efficiently monitor impacts. Customer enablement efforts, such as a public webinar and tailored support resources, are planned to foster adoption and engagement with the platform.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook 5.0, AI agents, Visual Editor, product analytics, Feature Flag Governance, experimentation scalability
